findings.title: Product pages detected but no Product JSON-LD found
findings.evidence: URL patterns suggest this site has product pages (paths matching /product/, /shop/, /item/), but no Product schema.org JSON-LD was found on any of them.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product JSON-LD to all product pages with at minimum: name, description, offers (price, priceCurrency, availability), image, brand.

findings.mechanism: Missing structured data deprives AI shopping engines of explicit product pricing, availability, and attributes needed for conversational recommendations.

findings.title: No content freshness signals found on any page
findings.evidence: Checked 15 pages. 0 pages contain dateModified, datePublished (JSON-LD), article:modified_time, or og:updated_time (meta tags). AI crawlers cannot determine whether this site's content is current.

suggested_action.summary: Add datePublished and dateModified to all Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD. Add <meta property='article:modified_time' content='...ISO date...'> to all content pages. Include <lastmod> dates in your sitemap.xml.

findings.mechanism: Absence of publication and modification timestamps prevents AI crawlers from determining content recency, causing search engines to de-prioritize indexing.

findings.title: No sameAs links in any JSON-LD block
findings.evidence: Crawled 12 pages including homepage and /about. 0 pages contain a 'sameAs' property in any JSON-LD entity. Without sameAs, AI knowledge graphs cannot confidently link this site to its verified external identity on Wikidata, LinkedIn, or Crunchbase.

suggested_action.summary: Add a 'sameAs' array to your Organization JSON-LD on the homepage. Minimum recommended links: LinkedIn company page, Crunchbase profile. For highest-trust disambiguation: create a Wikidata entry and link to it. Example: "sameAs": ["https://www.linkedin.com/company/...", "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q..."]

findings.mechanism: Without external sameAs authority links, AI knowledge graphs cannot confidently associate the brand with verified registry profiles.

findings.title: No Organization JSON-LD found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Crawled 12 pages. No JSON-LD with @type Organization, LocalBusiness, or equivalent was found. AI assistants use Organization markup as the primary entity anchor for a brand.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD to your homepage with: name, legalName, url, description, logo, sameAs, contactPoint. Reference: https://schema.org/Organization

findings.mechanism: Missing Organization structured data deprives AI engines of the primary anchor entity required to establish brand identity and authority.

findings.title: JSON-LD @context is not schema.org across 7 pages
findings.evidence:
Found JSON-LD blocks where @context is not 'https://schema.org' across 7 pages:
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-runner-nz-slip-on-mushroom (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-dasher-nz-blizzard-deep-navy (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-cruiser-canvas-port (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-dasher-nz-anthracite (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-cruiser-medium-grey (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-tree-runner-nz-medium-grey (context: '(empty string)')
- https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-runner-nz-medium-grey (context: '(empty string)')
Expected '@context': 'https://schema.org'.

suggested_action.summary: Set @context to 'https://schema.org' in all JSON-LD blocks across all pages.

findings.mechanism: Invalid or empty JSON-LD @context declarations cause schema parsers to reject structured data payloads entirely.

findings.title: Blog/article pages detected but no Article JSON-LD found
findings.evidence: URL patterns suggest this site has blog or article pages, but no Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD was found. AI assistants rely on Article markup to properly attribute authored content.

suggested_action.summary: Add Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD to all blog posts with: headline, datePublished, dateModified, author (Person with name), image.

findings.mechanism: Omission of Article schema prevents AI retrieval systems from indexing authored editorial content and publication dates.

findings.title: Render check inconclusive for 3 pages — possible JS gate or consent wall
findings.evidence:
After consent-banner dismissal and extended waits, 3 page(s) returned rendered text that was less than 20% of the raw-HTML word count. This typically means content is behind a JavaScript gate, cookie-consent paywall, or login wall that automated rendering cannot reliably pass. Render-gap analysis could not run for these pages:
  - https://www.allbirds.com
  - https://www.allbirds.com/pages/help
  - https://www.allbirds.com/pages/materials-making

suggested_action.summary: Ensure primary page content is accessible without requiring JavaScript interaction, login, or cookie acceptance. AI crawlers and search bots may not execute JS or accept consent prompts, making this content invisible to them.

findings.mechanism: Client-side consent walls or JavaScript rendering barriers prevent non-interactive AI crawlers from parsing primary page content.

findings.title: About page lacks sufficient disambiguating identity facts (score: 2/6)
findings.evidence: About page: https://www.allbirds.com/our-story. Detected disambiguating facts: location hq, industry vertical. Missing categories: founding year, team size, customer count, geographic reach. Generic About pages increase the risk of AI entity confusion.

suggested_action.summary: Improve the About page to include specific facts: founding year, HQ city/country, industry vertical, team size, customer count, and geographic reach. These specifics help AI models build an accurate entity profile.

findings.mechanism: Incomplete corporate background facts increase the likelihood that AI assistants confuse the brand with unrelated entities.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Cross-link verified entity profiles across independent authority platforms via sameAs
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Independent corroboration across Wikipedia, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, and Wikidata validates brand legitimacy and feeds entity resolution algorithms in knowledge graph construction.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: LLM knowledge engines construct high-confidence entity nodes by resolving bidirectional sameAs references across independent high-authority knowledge bases.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Publish a canonical facts page with unambiguous declarative plain-text assertions
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: A dedicated /facts or /about page presenting one unambiguous plain-text sentence per core attribute (founding date, headquarters, leadership, core products) eliminates extraction ambiguity for LLM crawlers.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Declarative single-fact sentences minimize semantic parsing entropy during retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and prevent hallucinated brand claims.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Structure conversational FAQ sections with question-shaped headings matching user prompts
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Formulating headings as explicit natural-language questions directly mirrors user prompt patterns submitted to AI search engines.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Question-formatted headings maximize semantic vector cosine similarity against conversational user queries, triggering direct answer citations.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Implement hreflang annotations and locale-specific schema for regional disambiguation
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Explicit hreflang link tags and localized schema markup distinguish regional product lines, currencies, and language variations for global AI assistants.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Locale and alternate tags prevent search bots from conflating regional entities or surfacing incorrect currency and availability in localized AI answers.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Embed machine-readable TL;DR summary blocks at the top of transactional emails
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: AI email summarizers (e.g., Apple Intelligence, Gemini in Gmail, Copilot) generate automatic summaries based on early email tokens, requiring key details upfront.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Structured key-value summary blocks at the beginning of email HTML ensure client-side AI summarizers extract order numbers, dates, and actions without truncation errors.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Maintain accurate <lastmod> timestamps in sitemap.xml to signal content freshness
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Including precise, genuine <lastmod> dates in sitemap.xml enables AI crawlers with limited crawl budgets to discover and ingest fresh updates promptly.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: AI search engines prioritize re-crawling URLs with recent sitemap <lastmod> timestamps, keeping their retrieval indexes and vector embeddings synchronized.
